sec.title: September 5 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 783)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 5** across psychological detective investigations on *The Crime Files of Flamond* starring Everett Clarke and a young Mike Wallace (as Myron Wallace), British panel satire on *I'm Sorry I Haven't a Clue* hosted by Humphrey Lyttelton (*The Artists Ball* [1978] and *The Hollywood Ball* [1981]), patriotic marches on *Cities Service Highways in Melody*, and James Melton singing operatic ballads on the *Texaco Star Theatre*, Everett Clarke (1946), Humphrey Lyttelton (1978–1981), and James Melton (1943–1955):
